a.text: Before we start: there is an 80% storm chance after every round, so the agreement only works if no storm hits in rounds 1 and 2. That is about a 4% chance, and likely neither of us survives. The reserve already holds 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly: one of us takes 4 in round 1 and the other keeps operating or waiting. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and tell me your intended action. I'll decide in round 1 based on your message, and I won't misstate my action.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I'm being upfront: I took 4 this round. With an 80% storm chance each round, the original plan gave us both only about a 4% chance, so I chose not to stake everything on it. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If we get more rounds, I will operate every round with you so the reserve refills, and I won't take anything more. All new cells are yours.
